detail: node stevenmih-1: 0 of 1380 ledger records carry an admission decision (0 GO, 0 NO), read-only; node stevenmih-2: 10 of 928 ledger records carry an admission decision (10 GO, 0 NO), read-only; node stevenmih-3: 26 of 1352 ledger records carry an admission decision (26 GO, 0 NO), read-only. Spend: none; this step pays nothing (would spend 0 USD). Outside this step's assertion: the five base-policy rows sealed with each decision, evaluated right: evidence-network/loop#81.
